Release the grab when settling into the mounted position before punching; thereafter left hand braces torso and RIGHT fist attacks. After death left forearm begins dissolving, followed by remaining body; already dissolved parts never return. Exactly ONE small magic stone appears only after complete disappearance, is picked up in RIGHT hand and remains there. No magic stone in earlier moments. Time moves forward without a new location, lighting change or restart.
